title: Why Your Fingers Wrinkle
description:
Your fingers don't wrinkle because they soak up water. The leading explanation is that your nervous system narrows the blood vessels under your skin, which makes the skin sink into wrinkles. Fingers with nerve damage reportedly don't wrinkle. Some scientists think the wrinkles act like tire treads for gripping wet things, but studies disagree about whether they really help.

Sources: Wilder-Smith & Chow (2003) on vasoconstriction; Changizi (2011) rain-tread hypothesis; mixed grip studies (2014, 2021). The grip benefit is a hypothesis.

Do your fingers wrinkle fast or slow? Tell us in the comments.
